subject: Mutual action plan: SOC 2 / SIG & DPA clarifications and timeline
messages:
From: Sarah Park <sarah.park@pioneer.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Pioneer Legal <legal@pioneer.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Draft MAP & a few clarifying q's on SOC2 / DPA / retention

Marcus — thanks for the call earlier. Attached is our initial MAP template (very high level). Before we circulate internally I want to confirm a few security/compliance gates so we can put realistic dates in the plan: 

- SOC 2: we need the most recent Type II report and a short list of scoping (prod vs staging, retained logs, encryption at rest). Are those available?
- SIG/CAIQ: will Redwood complete the CAIQ or do you expect us to fill a shared copy and you mark sections?
- DPA: we need to review your DPA redline; legal will likely propose a 7-year backup retention carveout — that might be a dealbreaker for us.
- Data retention: Pioneer is strict on PII retention windows (primary data 7 years; transactional data 3 years; backups 7 years). We need to see how Redwood supports per-tenant retention controls or contractual limits.

Can you confirm which of the above pieces you can provide in the next 3 business days? If so we can aim for a 6–8 week evaluation + legal review timeline.

Appended: MAP draft (very short), contact for our security lead is cc'd.

Thanks,
Sarah Park
Director, Platform Integrations
Pioneer Financial
[Attachment: pioneer_map_draft_v0.3.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Park <sarah.park@pioneer.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Pioneer Legal <legal@pioneer.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Draft MAP & a few clarifying q's on SOC2 / DPA / retention

Sarah — appreciate the succinct list. Quick answers and next steps below.

1) SOC 2: we can provide our latest Type II (2025) and a one-page scoping summary by EOD tomorrow. See attached SOC2 summary for immediate questions.
[Attachment: redwood_soc2-summary-2025.pdf (application/pdf)]

2) SIG/CAIQ: Redwood maintains a master CAIQ; our security team can pre-fill most sections and leave vendor-specific claims for you to verify. If Pioneer prefers, we can start a collaborative copy and mark sections for your team.

3) DPA: thanks for flagging the 7-year backup ask — that's longer than our default. We'll share a proposed redline specifically addressing backup retention windows and carveouts. Expect a draft today for your legal to review.
[Attachment: redline_dpa_pioneer_v1.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

4) Data retention controls: Redwood supports configurable retention per customer for primary and analytic data. Backups are handled separately and are currently retained up to 365 days by policy, with longer retention possible via written agreement (we'll call that out in the DPA redline).

Proposed timeline (high level):
- Week 0: Share SOC2, CAIQ prefilled, DPA redline (this week)
- Week 1–2: Pioneer security/legal review; live Q&A session (set by Grace/Irène)
- Week 3–4: Narrow open items; procurement review; finalize DPA
- Week 5–6: Contract signatures + onboarding kickoff

If you agree, Grace will schedule a 30-min technical Q&A with your security lead; Irene will own the CAIQ exchange and Lauren will coordinate legal redline resolution.

I can commit Redwood to an 8-week close if there are no unexpected legal escalations; if the backup retention needs to be 7 years we should scope the tradeoffs (cost, isolation, HSM key escrow) early.

Next steps: I uploaded an updated MAP timeline (map_timeline_v2.xlsx) to our shared Drive and provided a DocuSign link for the DPA redline so your legal team can comment inline.

Thanks — talk soon.
Marcus
Director, Partnerships, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: map_timeline_v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Sarah Park <sarah.park@pioneer.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Draft MAP & a few clarifying q's on SOC2 / DPA / retention

Sarah / Marcus — quick technical note from security ops so your team can map acceptance criteria: 

- SOC 2 evidence we will provide: final Type II report (redacted), list of in-scope services, and our monitoring/alerting summary. This should satisfy standard SOC2 acceptance checks.
- SIG/CAIQ: we will start a pre-filled CAIQ and mark any compensating controls. Typical turnaround for a complete CAIQ answer set is 3–5 business days once we have the Pioneer scoping.
- Data retention: Redwood exposes retention policies at the tenant layer for primary + analytic data. Backups are immutable and currently on a 365-day cycle; we can propose an extended retention addendum but it requires procurement-approved budget for storage + longer retention SLAs.

Acceptance checklist I recommend adding to the MAP under the "security gates" section (short bullets):
1) SOC2 Type II (latest) uploaded and reviewed
2) CAIQ responses completed and shared
3) DPA redline resolved with retention windows and backup carveouts documented
4) Evidence of KMS integration and key rotation policy (one-page summary)
5) Agreed path for incident response escalation/personnel contact list

Irene
Security Engineering Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Pioneer Legal <legal@pioneer.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Sarah Park <sarah.park@pioneer.com>
Date: 2026-10-21T10:37:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Draft MAP & a few clarifying q's on SOC2 / DPA / retention

Marcus / Redwood team — attaching our edits to the DPA. Two high-level items: 

1) Backup retention: Pioneer requires a 7-year retention for backups containing regulated customer data; we understand this may be operationally expensive — please confirm whether Redwood can support this or if a carveout is required.
2) Subprocessor list and notification: need a contractual 30-day notice for any subprocessor changes.

We left comments in DocuSign and also attached a redline. If Redwood cannot match 7 years for backups, propose a commercial alternative (long-term archival SLA + separate budget line).

Link to DocuSign: https://docusign.com/xxxxxxxx-1234
[Attachment: pioneer_redline_comments.pdf (application/pdf)]

— Pioneer Legal

On Tue, Oct 20, 2026 at 08:22 AM Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com> wrote:
> Sarah / Marcus — quick technical note from security ops so your team can map acceptance criteria: 
> ...

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Park <sarah.park@pioneer.com>, Pioneer Legal <legal@pioneer.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-22T16:41:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Draft MAP & a few clarifying q's on SOC2 / DPA / retention — next steps

Thanks for the quick review and for surfacing the backup requirement. Proposed path forward so we can keep to the MAP and an 8-week close window: 

- Redwood will provide SOC2 Type II and CAIQ prefilled by EOD 10/23.
- Redwood legal (Lauren) to propose a retention compromise by 10/25: either (A) a 3-year default backup retention with an option for 7-year archival at additional cost documented in the DPA OR (B) a 7-year retention for "regulated" datasets scoped explicitly in Annex A (requires additional procurement approval).
- Security acceptance call: Irene + Grace to host a 45-min technical walkthrough with Pioneer sec on 10/26 (Irene to send invite).
- Pioneer legal to complete comments in DocuSign by 10/28; if any high-risk clauses remain, escalate to exec/legal (Marcus + Pioneer GC) for resolution the week of 10/29.

I'll update the MAP timeline with these commitments and assign internal owners. If Pioneer signs up to option (A) now, we can keep to the 6–8 week close; option (B) likely pushes the timeline depending on procurement approvals.

Attachments: updated MAP timeline and SOC2 summary uploaded to the shared Drive.

Best,
Marcus
Director, Partnerships, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: map_timeline_v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]
